# Protocol

Neura's wire protocol, package `neura.v1`: the robot runtime and the site gateway (`dataplane.proto`), the site agent and the control plane (`site.proto`), the gateway and its policy workers (`worker.proto`), and shared types (`common.proto`). Sources: [`proto/neura/v1`](https://github.com/rkd0608/neura/tree/main/proto/neura/v1).

### Message `Envelope`

Identity fields every data-plane message carries. A receiver drops any message whose identity does not match its current authority (design §5.2, §6).

| Field | Type | Number | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `protocol_version` | `ProtocolVersion` | 1 |  |
| `session_id` | `string` | 2 | Gateway-issued session identifier. |
| `lease_generation` | `uint64` | 3 | Monotonic lease generation for this robot, issued by the gateway (design §6.1). |
| `task_epoch` | `uint64` | 4 | Task epoch, owned and advanced only by the robot runtime (design §6.2). |
| `sequence` | `uint64` | 5 | Request sequence within the task epoch. Responses echo the request's sequence. |
| `artifact_digest` | `string` | 6 | Content digests of the active model artifact and execution profile. |
| `execution_profile_digest` | `string` | 7 |  |

## `neura/v1/dataplane.proto`

### Service `RobotGateway`

| RPC | Request | Response | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `OpenSession` | `OpenSessionRequest` | `OpenSessionResponse` | Request a lease for this robot. Returns BUSY (LEASE_BUSY) if another session holds it. |
| `Heartbeat` | `HeartbeatRequest` | `HeartbeatResponse` | Renew the lease and exchange link-timing measurements. |
| `Control` | `ControlRequest` | `ControlResponse` | Session control: epoch changes, invalidation and close. |
| `Stream` | `stream RobotMessage` | `stream GatewayMessage` | Observations up, action chunks down. One stream per session. |
| `GetAssignment` | `GetAssignmentRequest` | `Assignment` | Which revision this robot should run, with its contract documents, so the robot verifies what it will run itself (design §16). The robot switches at its own task boundary. |

### Message `Observation`

One observation, sent when the robot's queued actions fall to the refill threshold (§8).

| Field | Type | Number | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `envelope` | `Envelope` | 1 |  |
| `anchor_index` | `uint64` | 2 | Anchor index: the first action index the resulting chunk covers (§5.1). For replace, blend and rtc merges it is the action cursor at capture; for append it is the index just after the last queued action. |
| `queued_actions` | `uint32` | 3 | Actions still queued at send time. |
| `budget_us` | `uint64` | 4 | Relative budget: microseconds until the robot's queue starves, minus its margin (§8). |
| `capture_time_us` | `uint64` | 5 | Robot monotonic time the observation was assembled. |
| `state` | `repeated StateEntry` | 6 | Named state tensors, matching the artifact's state inputs. |
| `images` | `repeated Image` | 7 |  |
| `instruction` | `string` | 8 | Language instruction, if the model is language conditioned. |
| `frozen_prefix` | `Tensor` | 9 | For rtc merge mode: the frozen prefix of actions the robot will execute regardless (§5.3), shape [k, action_dim] in the model's action order and units. |

### Message `ActionChunk`

| Field | Type | Number | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `envelope` | `Envelope` | 1 | Echoes the request's identity exactly. |
| `start_index` | `uint64` | 2 | Index of the first action in `actions`; equals the request's anchor_index (§5.1). |
| `actions` | `Tensor` | 3 | Shape [chunk_length, action_dim], in the artifact's declared action order and units. |
| `actions_digest` | `PayloadDigest` | 4 |  |
| `trace_id` | `string` | 5 | Opaque reference to the worker trace for this inference. |

### Message `RequestRejected`

| Field | Type | Number | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `envelope` | `Envelope` | 1 |  |
| `reason` | `Reason` | 2 |  |

## `neura/v1/site.proto`

### Service `SiteControl`

| RPC | Request | Response | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Enroll` | `EnrollRequest` | `EnrollResponse` | One-time enrollment of a server with a single-use enrollment token. The agent generates its key pair on the server; only the public key is sent (design §17.2). |
| `Connect` | `stream AgentMessage` | `stream ControlPlaneMessage` | Long-lived bidirectional stream opened by the site agent. Authenticated with a short-lived token the agent signs with its enrolled key ("authorization: Bearer &lt;JWT&gt;", EdDSA). |
| `FetchSealedWeights` | `FetchSealedWeightsRequest` | `stream SealedWeightsChunk` | A sealed weight file from Neura's registry (design §18.2), authenticated like Connect. The control plane only ever holds weights sealed with the customer's key; the agent opens them. |

### Message `ContactProof`

Proof that the control plane is in contact with this site: the manifest key's signature over CONTACT_PROOF_CONTEXT || site_id || 0x00 || nonce, where nonce came from the agent's SiteStatus. Only a verified proof renews offline authorization, so neither a replayed message nor a stream that stays open without the control plane behind it can extend it, and no clocks are compared across machines.

| Field | Type | Number | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `nonce` | `bytes` | 1 |  |
| `signature` | `Signature` | 2 |  |

### Message `UpgradeAgent`

Upgrade one server's agent to a signed release (design §17.3). The agent verifies the bundle against the release keys pinned on the server, stages it, switches at a task boundary, and rolls back by itself if the new release does not come up healthy.

| Field | Type | Number | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `server_id` | `string` | 1 |  |
| `version` | `string` | 2 |  |
| `bundle_url` | `string` | 3 | Where to fetch the release bundle: https:// (Neura's or the customer's mirror) or file://. |
| `bundle_sha256` | `string` | 4 | SHA-256 of the bundle file, hex. |

| `pid` | `uint32` | 11 | Operating-system process id, for diagnostics. |

### Message `WorkerInputs`

One request's inputs, decoded: state vectors by input name, images as H x W x 3 uint8 tensors by camera role, in the camera's declared color order.

| Field | Type | Number | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `state` | `repeated StateEntry` | 1 |  |
| `images` | `repeated ImagesEntry` | 2 |  |
| `instruction` | `string` | 3 |  |
| `frozen_prefix` | `Tensor` | 4 | Present only for real-time chunking (rtc) requests. |

| `inputs` | `repeated WorkerInputs` | 2 |  |
